# A tier switched off is a key like any other and carries where it came from,
# because "who turned this off" is exactly the question a person asks about it.
user {"store":"A","off":{"nas":"the share is gone"}}
# expect 1: ok
load
# expect 2: ok store=A/user off=nas/user [CFG-P1]
key off
# expect 3: ok value=nas from=user [CFG-P1]
